findings.issue: Card-building logic duplicates cardsFromPokemonRefs (pokeapi.js:127-151) just to attach the hidden-ability flag
findings.suggestion: Extend cardsFromPokemonRefs to accept a per-pokemon mapper (e.g. extra card fields from the entry) and delete the inline copy

findings.issue: refresh() fetches and replaces #results with no error handling; a failed request is an unhandled rejection and the UI silently stays stale
findings.suggestion: Wrap in try/catch and either fall back to a full navigation (location.assign(url)) or show an inline error

findings.issue: `species.varieties.find(...) ?? species.varieties[0]` throws a TypeError on a species with no varieties, producing a 500 where a 404/empty state is expected
findings.suggestion: Guard the fallback (e.g. `?? species.varieties.at(0)`) and treat a missing variety like a missing species

findings.issue: Unbounded process-lifetime Map cache plus memoized module singletons (pokeapi.js:94-152) are hidden global state; fine against this fixed snapshot but undocumented
findings.suggestion: Cap entries (LRU) or document expected cardinality; note that Astro 7's memoryCache() route caching could complement it for full-page responses

findings.issue: Type-label resolution `typeNames.get(t) ?? humanize(t)` is repeated in four files (also pokemon/[name].astro:97,135; moves/[name].astro:35; types/[name].astro:39)
findings.suggestion: Add a typeLabel(typeNames, name) helper (or return it from getTypeNameMap) in pokeapi.js

findings.issue: Uses `new URL(Astro.request.url)` instead of the documented, normalized Astro.url (same in pokemon/[name].astro:66)
The try/catch-404 + `!data ? <Layout title="Not found…">` dual-render pattern is duplicated across all four dynamic pages
findings.suggestion: Factor into a small helper (e.g. renderNotFound via a shared component that owns the Layout) or use Astro.rewrite('/404')

findings.issue: ~150 lines of frontmatter mixing version-group resolution, move-table construction and stats mapping make the heaviest page hard to skim
findings.suggestion: Extract move/version-group data shaping into src/lib (e.g. buildMovesTables(pokemon, gameName)) so the page reads as fetch → transform → render

findings.issue: Moves list is sorted by the humanized label, spec says alphabetically by name; can diverge for names whose humanization reorders words (e.g. 'v-create')
findings.suggestion: Sort by m.name (localeCompare) and display the label, or note the deliberate choice

findings.issue: popstate triggers a full location.reload(), discarding focus and scroll position after back/forward navigation
findings.suggestion: Re-run refresh(location.href) instead, or accept the reload and document it as deliberate

summary: A clean, current-Astro-7 SSR app that follows the framework's documented patterns (server output, node adapter, frontmatter data loading, documented 404 status handling) with deliberate handling of the genuinely risky parts: fan-out concurrency, cache failure eviction, stale-response races and alternate-form filtering. The main debt is consolidation, not design — a duplicated card builder, a four-times-repeated label fallback, one missing client-side catch and a fragile varieties fallback. I'd merge after one small round of fixes.
